svg.title: EHub Git Branching and Release Flow
svg.desc: Target Git Flow for task-scoped work branches, protected develop and main branches, staging acceptance, versioned releases, production deployments, retained inactive branch references and emergency hotfixes.
svg.text: EHub Git Branching and Release Flow
Target workflow from task-scoped work branches to versioned, verified and recoverable production releases

g.text: Sync production fix back to develop
No direct push to develop or main
Merged branches stay inactive and are never reused
